_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "servers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoints_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "capabilities_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_used_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artists" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_name" TEXT NULL, "cover_art" TEXT NULL, "album_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "music_brainz_id" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, "starred_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sync_run" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_name" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "cover_art" TEXT NULL, "song_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "music_brainz_id" TEXT NULL, "record_label" TEXT NULL, "is_compilation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_compilation" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "starred_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "play_count" INTEGER NULL, "dominant_color" INTEGER NULL, "thumb_hash" TEXT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sync_run" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "album_id" TEXT NULL, "artist_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "track_no" INTEGER NULL, "disc_no" INTEGER NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "cover_art" TEXT NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "size" INTEGER NULL, "suffix" TEXT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NULL, "bit_rate" INTEGER NULL, "sampling_rate" INTEGER NULL, "bit_depth" INTEGER NULL, "channels" INTEGER NULL, "path" TEXT NULL, "music_brainz_id" TEXT NULL, "isrc" TEXT NULL, "rg_track_gain" REAL NULL, "rg_album_gain" REAL NULL, "rg_track_peak" REAL NULL, "rg_album_peak" REAL NULL, "starred_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "play_count" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "missing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("missing" IN (0, 1)), "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "audio_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sync_run" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "is_ref" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_ref" IN (0, 1)), "file_id" TEXT NULL, "artists_json" TEXT NULL, "video_id" TEXT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "explicit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("explicit" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL, "is_public" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_public" IN (0, 1)), "readonly" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("readonly" IN (0, 1)), "valid_until_ms" INTEGER NULL, "cover_art" TEXT NULL, "song_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "changed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "member_set_hash" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "entries_fetched_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "entries_stamp" TEXT NULL, "sync_run" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_entries" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "playlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NULL, "server_position" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "playlist_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pins" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'original', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "target_type", "target_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "downloads" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "expected_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'original', "source_audio_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "stale" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stale" IN (0, 1)), "last_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "orphaned_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "refresh_quality" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_errors" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "played_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "listened_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fetched_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "track_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recommendations_cache" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "requests" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist" TEXT NOT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cover_fallbacks" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_aliases" ("server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_playlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server_id", "local_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "leases" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "until_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));
CREATE INDEX idx_artists_name ON artists (server_id, name)
CREATE INDEX idx_albums_artist ON albums (server_id, artist_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_albums_created ON albums (server_id, created_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_albums_name ON albums (server_id, name)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracks_album ON tracks (server_id, album_id, disc_no, track_no)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracks_artist ON tracks (server_id, artist_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracks_starred ON tracks (server_id, starred_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracks_created ON tracks (server_id, created_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_tracks_run ON tracks (server_id, sync_run)
CREATE INDEX idx_entries_track ON playlist_entries (server_id, track_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_downloads_state ON downloads (server_id, state)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_due ON outbox (status, next_attempt_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_history_played ON play_history (server_id, played_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_history_track ON play_history (server_id, track_id)
